candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause inside order (db, payment, inventory) not established; only the failing hop is bounded.

report.explanation: Traces and logs consistently show gateway POST /v1/checkout returning 502 because the downstream order service returns 500 on POST /v1/orders across multiple correlation IDs. Topology confirms gateway->order dependency. The bounded fault is an order-service 500; the internal cause within order is not yet evidenced.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for the failing POST /v1/orders requests to identify the internal error source
Order dependency metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory) to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or downstream-latency
